title: Scarab Pope on Dung Throne
description: A surreal black and white illustration features a giant anthropomorphic scarab beetle wearing an ornate papal tiara and mitre, seated atop a massive pile of dung and golden rings. The beetle has multiple arms holding lit candles and a curved sword while surrounded by glowing orbs and silhouetted robed worshippers in a dark, inky atmosphere.
prompt: A surreal black and white illustration of a giant anthropomorphic scarab beetle as a pope wearing an ornate papal crown, seated on a massive mound of dung and golden rings. The beetle has six arms, some holding lit candles and a curved sword. Silhouetted robed worshippers kneel before it. Floating glowing orbs and mystical symbols fill the dark inky background with dramatic lighting and splatter effects.
